summary: Unpinned GitHub dependency executes attacker-controlled code on install
details: package.json declares the runtime dependency `libsignal` as `github:wanzchil/libsignal-node` with no tag, version, or commit SHA. On `npm install`, npm resolves this reference to whatever bytes currently sit at the default branch HEAD of that GitHub repository and runs any lifecycle scripts inside them, with no integrity check or pin. Whoever controls that repository controls code that executes on the installer's machine at install time; the contents can change silently after publish without any new release of this package. A separate static match on `lib/Utils/generics.js:403` involving a `ping`/network command is a lower-signal keyword co-occurrence in a large source tree and is not independently corroborated.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
